basis: Effective seasonal performance of installed Swedish systems, for converting simulated heat demand to purchased energy.

heat_pump.source_locator: Haglund Stignor, Tiljander and Alsbjer (2015), 24th IIR International Congress of Refrigeration: field SPF of ground-source heat pumps in existing Swedish houses, average 2.7 in year 1 and 2.9 in year 2 (range 1.9-3.6). Swedish exhaust-air installations average 2.7 (Nowacki, cited by Hesaraki and Holmberg 2013; cited from epsm_studies calibration_plan.md, revision 5).
heat_pump.note: One field-average value for every heat-pump type and era. A modern SPF of 3.9 or 3.5 for new ground-source houses was rejected in the cohort validation (calibration_plan.md, revision 5).
